article.title: Echoes of COINTELPRO w/ Watani Stiner & Kazu Haga
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: On January 17, 1969, an altercation at UCLA ended in gunfire that left two members of the Black Panther Party dead. Watani Stiner–who was a member of the conflicting Us Organization–was there that day. But despite not shooting anyone, he and his brother George were sentenced to life in prison for conspiracy to commit murder and second-degree murder. He spent the next several decades in prison… Source
